stemMd: Which response to a failed replication would both authors reject?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The original effect is genuine, but every failure is explained by unspecified uniqueness of the new setting.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Compare settings using a preregistered measure of participant experience.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Test a proposed temperature dependence in a new experiment.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Reduce confidence while investigating a concrete contextual explanation.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Revise the scope of a claim when new comparative evidence supports doing so.

explanationMd: Unspecified uniqueness protects the claim from contradiction without generating predictions. Both passages explicitly reject that response, even though each allows context to matter when it is made testable.

distractorRationale.c: The first explicitly recommends such testing.
distractorRationale.b: This generates a testable scope claim.
distractorRationale.d: That combines the two authors' concerns.
